input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi, just my phone’s internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

I checked my phone’s status bar, and it shows that Airplane Mode is on, and there’s something about a VPN being connected. The battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about signal strength or network type right now. What should I do next?

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar for signal strength, it says 2G, and it looks like data is disabled. There’s still something about a VPN connected, and the battery is still at 80%. What should I do next?

I’ve turned on mobile data. Now I still see just one bar for signal strength, it says 2G, and data is enabled. There’s also something called “Data Saver” showing, and the VPN is still connected. What should I do next?
I changed the network mode to 4G/5G preferred. Now I see four bars for signal strength, it says 5G, and data is enabled. Data Saver and VPN are still showing. What should I do next?

I turned off Data Saver mode and disconnected the VPN. Now the status bar shows four bars for signal strength, 5G, and data is enabled. The Data Saver and VPN icons are gone. What should I do next? Should I try a speed test now?
I tried to run a speed test, but it says there’s no connection. I’m not sure what happened—I still see four bars and 5G on my phone. What should I do now?
I’ve reset the APN settings, but it says the changes will take effect after I restart my phone. I’m a bit nervous about rebooting—will I lose any of my photos or anything important if I do this?

I restarted my phone and tried the speed test again, but it still says there’s no connection. I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why isn’t this working when I have full bars and 5G showing? What else can we try?

Oh, I definitely don’t want to change my plan—I just want to add more data for now. Please go ahead and add 2GB for me. I really need to get excellent internet speed working on my phone. What do I need to do next after you add the data?

I restarted my phone again, but the speed test still says there’s no connection. I’m really getting worried now—why isn’t it working even after adding more data? I just want to have excellent internet speed like you promised. What else can we try?

I checked everything you mentioned: mobile data is enabled, Airplane Mode is off, Wi-Fi is off, and I see four bars with 5G in the status bar. There aren’t any error messages or unusual icons showing. What should I do next?

I reseated the SIM card and restarted my phone, but the speed test still says there’s no connection. Everything on the status bar still looks normal—four bars, 5G, and data enabled. I’m really starting to feel overwhelmed. Is there anything else we can try to finally get excellent internet speed?

You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi, just my phone’s internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?

I can help you troubleshoot and improve your mobile data speed. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID (if you know it)?

Once I have this information, I can check your line and guide you through the steps to improve your mobile data speed.
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

Thank you for providing your information. To help you get the best mobile data speed, I’ll guide you through a few steps to check your phone’s current status and settings.

First, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If you see any icons like “✈️ Airplane Mode,” “📵 No Signal,” or “📱 Data Enabled/Disabled”
- What your signal strength looks like (bars or icons like “📶¹”, “📶²”, “📶³”, “📶⁴”)
- If you see a network type indicator (like “5G”, “4G”, “LTE”, “3G”, or “E”)

This will help me understand your current connection and guide you to the next step. If you’re not sure how to check, let me know and I can walk you through it!
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I checked my phone’s status bar, and it shows that Airplane Mode is on, and there’s something about a VPN being connected. The battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about signal strength or network type right now. What should I do next?

Since Airplane Mode is on, your phone’s mobile data and cellular service are disabled, which is why you’re not seeing any signal strength or network type. To restore your connection and improve your data speed, please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone.

Here’s how you can do it:
1. Swipe down from the top of your screen to open the quick settings menu.
2. Look for the airplane icon (✈️) and tap it to turn Airplane Mode off.

Once you’ve done that, check if your signal bars and network type (like 4G or 5G) appear. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and we’ll continue troubleshooting from there.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar for signal strength, it says 2G, and it looks like data is disabled. There’s still something about a VPN connected, and the battery is still at 80%. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Here’s what we’ll do next to improve your mobile data speed:

1. Turn on your mobile data, since it’s currently disabled.
2. Change your network mode from 2G to a faster option (like 4G or 5G).
3. Disconnect the VPN, as it can sometimes slow down your connection.

Let’s start by turning on your mobile data. Please go to your phone’s settings or quick settings menu and enable mobile data. Once it’s on, let me know if you see a change in your signal strength or network type. After that, I’ll guide you through the next steps.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve turned on mobile data. Now I still see just one bar for signal strength, it says 2G, and data is enabled. There’s also something called “Data Saver” showing, and the VPN is still connected. What should I do next?

Great job turning on mobile data. Here’s what we’ll do next to improve your speed:

1. Change your network mode from 2G to a faster option (4G or 5G).
2. Turn off Data Saver mode, as it can restrict your data speed.
3. Disconnect the VPN, since it can slow down your connection.

Let’s start by changing your network mode:
- Go to your phone’s settings.
- Find “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Network.”
- Look for “Preferred network type” or “Network mode.”
- Select “4G/5G preferred” or the highest available option.

After you’ve changed the network mode, let me know if your network type changes from 2G to something faster (like 4G or 5G). Then I’ll guide you through turning off Data Saver and disconnecting the VPN.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
I changed the network mode to 4G/5G preferred. Now I see four bars for signal strength, it says 5G, and data is enabled. Data Saver and VPN are still showing. What should I do next?

That’s excellent progress! Now, let’s turn off Data Saver mode and disconnect the VPN to further improve your data speed.

Please follow these steps:

1. Turn off Data Saver mode:
   - Go to your phone’s settings.
   - Find “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
   - Tap on “Data Saver.”
   - Turn Data Saver OFF.

2. Disconnect the VPN:
   - Go to your phone’s settings.
   - Find “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
   - Tap on “VPN.”
   - Select the active VPN and disconnect it.

After you’ve completed these steps, let me know if you notice any improvement in your data speed or if the Data Saver and VPN icons disappear from your status bar. If you’d like, I can also guide you through running a speed test to check your connection quality.

Data Saver Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

VPN disconnected successfully.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

I turned off Data Saver mode and disconnected the VPN. Now the status bar shows four bars for signal strength, 5G, and data is enabled. The Data Saver and VPN icons are gone. What should I do next? Should I try a speed test now?

Yes, you should try running a speed test now to check your current mobile data speed and ensure everything is working at its best.

Please use your phone’s browser or a speed test app (such as Ookla Speedtest or Fast.com) to run a speed test. After the test, let me know your download speed result and if your browsing or app experience has improved.

If you need help running the speed test or interpreting the results, just let me know!
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried to run a speed test, but it says there’s no connection. I’m not sure what happened—I still see four bars and 5G on my phone. What should I do now?

Thank you for letting me know. Since you see four bars and 5G, but the speed test says there’s no connection, there may be an issue with your phone’s network settings or APN (Access Point Name) configuration.

Let’s try resetting your APN settings to default, which often resolves this type of issue. Here’s how you can do it:

1. Go to your phone’s Settings.
2. Tap on “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
3. Select “Mobile Network.”
4. Tap on “Access Point Names” or “APN.”
5. Look for an option to “Reset to default” or “Reset settings” and select it.

After resetting your APN settings, please restart (reboot) your phone to apply the changes. Once your phone restarts, try running the speed test again and let me know if your connection is working. If you need step-by-step guidance for your specific phone model, let me know!

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve reset the APN settings, but it says the changes will take effect after I restart my phone. I’m a bit nervous about rebooting—will I lose any of my photos or anything important if I do this?

You will not lose any of your photos, contacts, or important information by restarting (rebooting) your phone. Restarting simply turns your phone off and back on, which helps apply the new network settings.

It’s a safe and common step in troubleshooting. Please go ahead and restart your phone. Once it’s back on, try running the speed test again and let me know how it goes. If you have any concerns or questions during the process, I’m here to help!
